about.intro: This website is designed for A/L Physics learners who want a clear, focused, and professional study experience.
about.philosophyText: The focus is on helping students understand the logic beneath each concept, build confidence in problem solving, and study with structure.
about.approachText: Every lesson is shaped around understanding, practice, and application so students can connect theory to questions and real-world thinking.
about.focusText: The learning path is centred on core A/L Physics topics, careful explanations, and step-by-step revision support.
